answer: Each agent identity is admitted by a TPM/SGX enclave producing a zero-knowledge attestation bound to the thread state tree; comet is a hash anchor, and timber is the consensus contract recording it. Forging an identity requires physically compromising enclave hardware and extracting replay-resistant keys, while each additional identity incurs a quadratic O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversible collateral slashing, making Sybil expansion superlinear.
